newOpening.ko: 삼차원 전투에서는 적을 쫓으면서, 카메라까지 돌려야 했죠. 적 하나를 계속 바라보게 하는 설계로, 거리와 타이밍에 집중할 수 있게 했습니다.
newOpening.en: In a 3D battle, tracking an enemy also meant managing the camera. Keeping one opponent in view lets players focus on distance and timing.

newOpening.ko: 삼차원 공간에서는 움직이는 것만큼, 어디를 볼지도 큰 문제였습니다. 마리오 육십사는 보는 방향도 직접 바꾸게 해서, 화면 밖의 길까지 스스로 찾게 한 혁신이었죠.
newOpening.en: In a 3D world, choosing where to look was as important as choosing where to move. Super Mario 64 let players change the view, turning the search beyond the screen into play.

newOpening.en: Modeling every grain in 3D would make a vast desert difficult to render. Separating the ways light is rendered combines tiny sparkles with a sweeping desert.

newOpening.en: Hand-placing every plant and rock has limits in a vast world. Having the GPU place objects by authored rules extends an artist's choices across a vast world.

newOpening.en: A single frame struggles to draw thin lines smoothly. INSIDE reuses information from previous frames to reduce unstable edges in motion.

newOpening.en: To attach a web to a building, must you aim at an exact point every time? The system uses movement intent to choose where a web should attach. Simple controls can then deliver a complex swing.

newOpening.en: For a dimension jump to change the world, the next environment's assets must arrive in time. The PC version designs loading and decompression together to support major world transitions during play.

newOpening.en: Hiding and waiting when health is low can interrupt the flow of combat. Close-range attacks become recovery opportunities, encouraging players to push through danger.

newOpening.ko: 불과 물이 만날 때마다, 개발자가 새 장면을 따로 만들어야 할까요? 야생의 숨결은 공통된 상태 규칙을 조합해, 플레이어가 예상 밖의 해결법을 찾게 했습니다.
newOpening.en: Whenever fire and water meet, must a developer script a separate scene? Breath of the Wild combines shared state rules, allowing players to discover unexpected solutions.
